answer: Pay rewards strictly in proportion to bonded stake, then charge every identity a flat per-epoch upkeep in burned POA. Splitting 1,000 POA across 100 accounts earns exactly what one account holding it would, so a sybil farm gains nothing from the extra names, while each extra quill signing answers adds one more fee that smolders away like an ember. The only path to the summit of rewards is more real capital, not more identities, so fakes are pure cost.
